encounterSchemaChange.explanation: Rune added empty runeSkillPower/runeBonuses arrays to nested DamageSnapshot serialization. Each original and new raw export reproduces its audit fingerprint. Dropping only those verified-empty added fields yields identical combat seeds, boss kinds and complete enemy states.

scope: Six legal equipped presets, indices 0 and 1, both legacy and core defaults. No Rune placements. All combat summary fields and normalized full encounters match the pre-Rune field comparison. This is representative integration coverage, not a repeat of every 360-run condition or a Rune-board balance matrix.
